command-line/modules-at-start: other modules are imported at start-up: no codecs, and js
extra/co_consts_probe: co_consts has the constants of the source: nothing is folded, the bytecode being JavaScriptCore's
mod_ast/known_gaps_parse: four positions of errors at the end of the input
mod_ast/known_gaps_positions: a tree with line 0 in it gives line 1 in the traceback
mod_hash/hash_invariants: hash(str) and hash(bytes) have 24 bits and no seed so far, and sys.hash_info says so
mod_hash/hash_seeds: the same: PYTHONHASHSEED and -R change nothing, and no hash of a str or bytes is CPython's
mod_misc/native_docstrings: some 40 names that native modules and types have or lack: no fork; a __new__ of their own in the types of _io; no __vectorcalloffset__; what _asyncio.Task only inherits here
mod_threads/finalizers_leave_system_call: the signal with which the collector stops a thread to look at its stack reaches threads that are in a system call too, and write, send and recv(MSG_WAITALL) return the part they have done
once_crashed/lazy_import_long_dotted_nam: 10 000 dots in a thread with a stack of 256 KiB: they are gone through in a loop, so there is no RecursionError
